dates.time: 12:00 Europe/Vienna (UTC+1, UTC+2 in summer time); before 1970: 1970-01-01 UTC, seconds apart

scope.when_absent: this corpus records no scope notes (no commit carries Applies:); the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.meaning: a law applies to facts from the day it takes effect and does not affect earlier acts or rights acquired before then, unless it says otherwise; in criminal law a later law applies to earlier acts only where it is more favourable to the offender
default_reach.authority: § 5 ABGB ("Gesetze wirken nicht zurück und haben daher auf vorhergegangene Handlungen und auf vorher erworbene Rechte keinen Einfluß."); § 1 and § 61 StGB; Art. 7 EMRK
